topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic serves as the lecture's opening framing, introducing the topic of complement and contextualizing its complexity.

topics.label: Fundamentals and Core Principles of the Complement Cascade
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational principles, nomenclature rules, and central biochemical role of C3 activation in the complement system.

topics.label: Complement Activation Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three upstream recognition pathways that initiate complement activation and converge on the C3 convertase threshold.

topics.label: Effector Mechanisms of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream mechanisms through which the activated complement cascade targets and eliminates pathogens.

topics.label: Host Regulation of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that protect host cells from unintended complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Clinical Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the diverse clinical manifestations and disease presentations resulting from deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how pathogens evade complement attack, focusing on Staphylococcus aureus mechanisms and the practical applications of its evasion proteins.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the lecture's closing framing, wrapping up the discussion of complement and previewing the next lecture topic.
